items.hook: The Broken Amoretti (ISBN 9789386906830) is a literary novel written by Sudipto Das and Aparajita Dutta.

items.hook: British airship R-38 experiences structural failure over Hull in England and crashes in the Humber Estuary; of her 49 British and American training crew, only four survive.
items.body: The R.38 class of rigid airships was designed for Britain's Royal Navy during the final months of the First World War. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Edirne event: Sultan Mustafa II of the Ottoman Empire is dethroned.
items.body: The Edirne Incident was a janissary revolt that began in Constantinople in 1703. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: The Western Roman army under Stilicho corners and defeats the Ostrogothic army in the battle of Faesulae.
items.body: In modern scholarship, the "late" period of the Roman army begins with the accession of the Emperor Diocletian in AD 284, and ends in 480 with the death of Julius Nepos, being roughly coterminous with the Dominate. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: The Marble Statue is an 1818 novella by the German writer Joseph von Eichendorff.
items.body: Set around Lucca, it is about a man who struggles to choose between piety, represented by a musician and a beautiful maiden, and a world of art, represented by a statue of Venus. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.hook: True History of the Kelly Gang is a 2000 novel by Australian writer Peter Carey, loosely based on the life of Ned Kelly and his gang.
items.body: Written as a fictional memoir as if by Kelly, the novel draws on the style of the bushranger's Jerilderie Letter and reimagines the events of his life in colonial Australia. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: A Forest of Wool and Steel is a 2018 Japanese drama film directed by Kojiro Hashimoto and starring Kento Yamazaki.
items.body: It is based on the 2016 award-winning Booksellers novel by Natsu Miyashita, which tells the story of high school student Naoki Tomura and his ambition to become a piano tuner. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi is overthrown after the National Transitional Council forces take control of Bab al-Azizia compound during the Libyan Civil War.
items.body: Muammar Muhammad Abu Minyar al-Gaddafi was a Libyan military officer, revolutionary, politician, and political theorist who ruled Libya as a dictator from 1969 until his overthrow by Libyan rebel forces in 2011 during the First Libyan Civil War. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.
